title: the same no-index fMP4 when all bytes are local

definition.title: the same no-index fMP4 when all bytes are local
definition.source_excerpt: Loaded as a Blob, the same file exposed a seekable 0–6 s interval. Seeking to 4.2 s and playing produced frame callbacks beginning at 4.233333 s and advanced normally. Implication. Lack of an explicit random-access trailer can be acceptable for a fully local/in-memory object because there is no network byte-fetch penalty. Route choice should therefore depend on byte locality, not just container syntax.
